title: Large Deviations Techniques and Applications
relevance: Standard reference for large deviation theory; provides the mathematical framework for quantifying the probability and structure of rare long odd-step runs in Collatz trajectories.

title: Syracuse conjecture and continued fractions
relevance: Connects Collatz dynamics to continued fraction expansions, providing analytic tools for understanding trajectory structure under the random walk heuristic.

title: Paradoxical behavior in Collatz sequences
relevance: Studies anomalous trajectory behavior in Collatz sequences, directly relevant to understanding why CRT-constructed numbers with long odd runs may or may not achieve record delays.
